Container.Name: Broadwave
Container.Overview: Live TV and DVR for your antenna. Finds your HDHomeRun, fills a 14-day guide, records the original broadcast, and shares one tuner with every screen in the house, in sync. Apps for iPhone and Apple TV find this server on their own.
Container.Requires: An HDHomeRun tuner on the same network. Host networking lets the server find it and lets the apps find the server. Remove --device=/dev/dri if the server has no Intel or AMD graphics.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, guide, and live buffer. Put this on a fast pool.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where recordings are saved as original broadcast files.

Config.Name: Tuner address
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed if the tuner is on another subnet or the container is not on host networking.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the guide, like America/Chicago.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id for recordings. 99 is Unraid's nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id for recordings. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask for new recordings.
